quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #13
										  					
  

18 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: What is defensive driving?

options.text: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to avoid crashes.
Protecting yourself from bad drivers by passing them.
Following the car ahead very closely.
Changing lanes quickly to get through traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to avoid crashes.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means you notice dangerous situations and act before a crash happens. It helps you avoid problems with reckless, careless, or impaired drivers and pedestrians.

questions.question: When can you cross a solid yellow line?

options.text: To pass a car going the same direction.

questions.explanation: You can cross broken lines, but not solid lines. You can only cross a solid yellow line when you are making a turn.

questions.question: Why must you be extra careful around a pedestrian with a white cane?
questions.explanation: A white cane means the person is blind. Slow down, give them the right-of-way, and be ready to stop to keep them safe.

questions.question: When you see a stopped emergency vehicle with flashing lights, you must:

options.text: Slow down and change lanes if possible so you do not drive next to it.
Drive to the right and stop.
Stay in your lane and keep driving at the same speed.
Speed up to pass it quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and change lanes if possible so you do not drive next to it.
questions.explanation: When you see a stopped emergency vehicle with flashing lights, change lanes to give it space. If you cannot change lanes safely, slow down below the speed limit and give it as much room as possible. Always be ready to stop.

questions.question: You must use your headlights when you cannot see other vehicles for ____ feet ahead.
questions.explanation: State law requires headlights any time you cannot see pedestrians or other vehicles 1,000 feet ahead of your car.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you of a curve in the road.

questions.question: When passing a bicycle, you should:

options.text: Leave at least four feet of space.
Stay on the right side of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave at least four feet of space.
questions.explanation: The law requires you to leave at least four feet of space between your vehicle and a bicycle when passing.

questions.question: What is the penalty for a person under 21 who drinks alcohol but is not driving, for a first offense?

options.text: 90-day license suspension and up to $500 fine.

questions.correctAnswerText: 90-day license suspension and up to $500 fine.
questions.explanation: The minimum penalties for underage drinking on a first offense are a fine of up to $500, court costs, and a 90-day license suspension.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow line on your side of the centerline mean?
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line on your side means you cannot pass.

questions.question: An oncoming driver's high beams are blinding you. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the oncoming car.
Toward the right side of the road.
Toward the left side of the road.
Straight down the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: When blinded by oncoming high beams, look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and lets you see enough of the road to stay on course until the other car passes.

questions.question: When you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm extended, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and wait until it is safe to go.
Honk your horn and pass on the left side.
Keep driving when you think all children have left the bus.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and wait until it is safe to go.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus has its stop arm extended. Do not move forward until the stop arm is raised.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road turns sharply to the right.
Another road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
The road curves back and forth.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: When driving in rain, you must use:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in the rain.

questions.question: Lines that divide traffic moving in opposite directions are ____ lines.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic that moves in opposite directions.

questions.question: You may drive around railroad crossing gates:
questions.explanation: Never drive around a lowered railroad crossing gate. Stop when you see warning signals. These include flashing red lights, lowered gates, a flagger, or a train whistle. Always wait until the gate is raised and the lights stop flashing.

questions.question: Smoking while driving:
questions.explanation: Smoking while driving takes your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road. This is a dangerous distraction.

questions.question: When making a turn, you must ____ your speed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when turning so you can stay in control, keep in your lane, and react to anything unexpected.

questions.question: When making a right turn, your car must be:

options.text: In the center of the street.
On the left side of the street.
On the right side of the street.
Past the center of the intersection when you start to turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the right side of the street.
questions.explanation: Move to the right side of the road before turning right. Do not cut across lanes of traffic to make any turn.
